acceptance:
(
 set -e
 export NO_COLOR=1 CI=1
export GOFLAGS=-mod=mod GOPROXY=off
P=$PWD/probe/x; mkdir -p $P
cat > $P/full.json <<'MORPH_CONF_EOF'
{"Replace":{"calc/b.go":"","report/c.go":""}}
MORPH_CONF_EOF
echo '== full'; go vet -overlay $P/full.json ./...
)

(
 set -e
 export NO_COLOR=1 CI=1
P=$PWD/probe/x; mkdir -p $P
cat > $P/probe.config.mts <<'MORPH_CONF_EOF'
export default defineConfig({});
MORPH_CONF_EOF
cat > $P/tsconfig.card.json <<'MORPH_TSCONF_EOF'
{
  "extends": "../../tsconfig.json",
  "include": [
    "../../src",
    "../../tests",
    "./*.probe.ts"
  ],
  "exclude": []
}
MORPH_TSCONF_EOF
echo '== tsc'; node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p $P/tsconfig.card.json
)
